message:
Let me check how the fuzzer is built and where the binary is. Let me look at the oss-fuzz build config:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'cat /gt/_work/src/oss-fuzz/config/* 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; ls /gt/_work/src/oss-fuzz/config/ 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; find / -name "*mruby*" -type f 2>/dev/null | grep -v "/gt/_work/src" | head -20' 2>&1 | head -60</｜｜DSML｜｜>
